name: Waxahachie Crossing
summary: Waxahachie Crossing is a community shopping center located on North Highway 77 in Waxahachie, Texas, managed by Kite Realty Group. The center serves the growing Ellis County market with convenient access to national retailers and everyday services in an open-air format.
demographics: Waxahachie Crossing serves a growing suburban family demographic in Ellis County, Texas, with a trade area characterized by middle-income households and young families drawn to the area's affordable housing and proximity to the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center attracts shoppers primarily in the 25-54 age range with household incomes between $50,000-$85,000, reflecting the community's mix of commuters and local residents. Shopping patterns emphasize convenience-oriented trips for groceries, everyday necessities, and family dining, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when working families complete their weekly errands.
description: Waxahachie Crossing is a community shopping center strategically located along North Highway 77 in Waxahachie, Texas, serving as a vital retail hub for this historic Ellis County community situated just south of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Developed and managed by Kite Realty Group, a leading retail real estate investment trust with an extensive portfolio across the United States, the center provides convenient access to everyday shopping and services for the rapidly growing Waxahachie area. The property benefits from its prominent highway frontage and visibility, drawing both local residents and travelers along this major north-south corridor connecting Dallas to communities throughout Central Texas. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily, Waxahachie Crossing offers a tenant mix designed to meet the daily needs of suburban families, featuring national retailers and service providers in an accessible open-air format. The center has earned strong community recognition with a 4.3-star rating from nearly 1,800 reviews, reflecting its role as a dependable shopping destination that balances convenience, value, and quality for Ellis County residents.
